FIELDS = ("name", "email", "phone")

    cols = [k for k in data if k in FIELDS]
    sets = ", ".join(f"{c}=:{c}" for c in cols)
    session.execute(text(f"UPDATE patients SET {sets} WHERE id = :pid"), {**data, "pid": pid})
